description_excerpt: We are looking forward to working with a passionate talent, specialized in Digital Verification at Hanoi. This position shall contribute to the creation and definition of verification plans, using Universal Verification Methodology (UVM). Your Role Key responsibilities in your new role • Create and define verification plans • Develop verification environments for our ICs using Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) • Draw on test scenarios using SystemVerilog • Verify functionality using the Constrained Random approach • Develop assertions in SystemVerilog for formal verification •…
